chunks: It is narrated by Suwayd al-Qallāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
The udhiyyah is obligatory upon whoever is able, whether young or old, and it is a sunnah (prophetic tradition).

key_terms.الْأُضْحِيَّةُ: the sacrificial offering performed on the occasion of Eid al-Adha
key_terms.سُنَّةٌ: an established prophetic tradition or recommended normative practice
key_terms.وَجَدَ: had the means or ability to afford it

ai.seo_question: Is the udhiyyah sacrifice obligatory for one who can afford it?
ai.summary: This hadith states the ruling of the sacrificial offering for one who possesses the means to perform it. It presents the udhiyyah as an emphasized ritual practice with normative legal significance in worship.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3043 - It is narrated from Suwayd al-Qallāʾ, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Imam Abu Jaʿfar (as), who said:
"The sacrifice (udhiyya) is obligatory upon anyone who can afford it, whether young or old, and it is also a sunnah."
